title: Gentle Breeze Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Gentle Breeze- Location! Location! Classic Seaside, FL beach cottage! Steps from West Side Pool, and a short walk to the beach and downtown. Enjoy Seaside at this prime location.
description_expanded: Description28 BUTLER STREET2 QUEENS, 1 BUNK BED W/TRUNDLE, 1 TWIN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 8) Welcome to Gentle Breeze – A Classic Seaside Cottage RetreatTucked away on charming Butler Street and just steps from the Westside Pool, Gentle Breeze is a cheerful coastal retreat offering the perfect blend of comfort, location, and classic Seaside charm. Just a short stroll from America’s favorite beach, this inviting three-bedroom cottage places you in the heart of Seaside, Florida—ideal for families or friends seeking an effortless coastal getaway.Inviting Outdoor Living & Curb AppealFrom the moment you arrive, Gentle Breeze welcomes you with its cheerful emerald-green exterior and relaxed coastal charm. The home features an open-air front porch with seating for four, overlooking a private fenced side yard—perfect for morning coffee or casual conversation. Around back, you’ll find a spacious covered porch with outdoor seating and ample storage for beach gear, as well as a rear deck with outdoor dining and a charcoal grill for easy family meals under the sun or stars.Open & Airy Main Living LevelStep inside to an open-concept main level designed for effortless gathering. The living area offers comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV, flowing seamlessly into the fully equipped kitchen with bar seating for three. Adjacent to the kitchen is a dining area that comfortably seats six, ideal for shared meals and evening conversations. Direct outdoor access enhances the indoor-outdoor lifestyle Seaside is known for.Comfortable Bedrooms & Private RetreatsUpstairs, you’ll find three thoughtfully designed bedrooms:Primary Suite: A spacious queen bedroom with a private ensuite bath, generous closet space, and its own open-air balcony overlooking a peaceful yard—perfect for unwinding after a beach day.Second Bedroom: Features a cozy double bed and access to a shared full bathroom.Third Bedroom: Ideal for kids or extra guests, this room includes a bunk bed with trundle and shares the full bathroom with the second bedroom.Your Perfect Seaside EscapeWith its central location, inviting outdoor spaces, and comfortable layout, Gentle Breeze offers everything you need for a memorable Seaside vacation. Whether you’re enjoying quiet mornings on the porch, afternoons at the beach, or evenings grilling in the backyard, this charming cottage invites you to slow down and savor the best of coastal living.*5-night minimum stay required during spring break and summer; 3 night minimum stay during fall; 2 night minimum stay during winter.FEATURES1,526 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Pensacola PavilionAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply) and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002148
